author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 — direct parallel: JmapBackend::query_objects has 8 positional args, query_changes has 9. Every new RFC param (anchor, anchorOffset, sortAsTree, filterAsTree) forces a breaking change at every call site. Bead recommends a Params struct.

Same shape as .19: replace positional args with a #[non_exhaustive] struct so additions are non-breaking. Same propagation cost: every *-server backend's query / query_changes impl changes. Defer to the same major-bump decision.
